units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 18:5">Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 5</cite> <he>הנכנס … במ׳</he> he who enters gentile lands … in a portable turret. Ohol. IV, 1, v. <cite ref="A00634"><he>אָוִיר</he></cite>.

Ḥag. 15ᵇ; Snh. 106ᵇ three hundred hălakhoth (about levitical cleanness) במ׳ הפורח באויר concerning a turret flying (moving) in the air (cmp. Tosef. l. c.); [oth. opin. = מ׳ העומד באויר, Ohol. l. c.; for oth. explan. v. Rashi to Ḥag. a. Snh. l. c.].—
<cite ref="Eruvin 34a:5">Erub. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ שאינו מסומר</he> a turret which is not fastened (which can be let up and down).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:3">Kel. XII, 3</cite> <he>מ׳ של בעלי וכ׳</he> a turret (spice chest) of private people, <he>של רופאים</he> of physicians.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 3:10">Tosef. Sot. III, 10</cite> <he>אנשי מ׳</he> the builders of the Tower of Babel, v. <cite ref="E00750"><he>הַפְלָגָה</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִגְדָּלִים</he>, <cite ref="M00125"><he>מִגְדָּלִין</he></cite>, <he>מִגְדָּלוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 4:8:3">Y. B. Bath. IV, 14ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 3:3">Tosef. B. Bath. III, 3</cite> <he>המ׳</he> the turrets (store closets) in bath-houses.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02901"><he>אֲקוּנְבִּי</he></cite>.
B. Mets. 25ᵃ עשויין כמ׳; Tosef. ib. II, 7 עשויות מגדלות coins piled up pyramidally; ib. מקצתן מגדלין some of them piled up; a. fr.—Esp. מִגְדָּל pr. n. pl. Migdal, Magdala, near Tiberias.

<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 6:13">Tosef. Erub. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 5:13">V</cite>), 13; Y. ib. V, 22ᵈ bot.—In compounds: <cite ref="M00121"><he>מִגְדַּל</he></cite>, e. g. <he>מ׳ עדר</he>, <he>מ׳ חרוב</he>, v. respective determinants.
